verifiedFindings: ConnectorModel unique key is @@unique([connectorId, modelKey]); provider is fixed per Connector, so the same modelKey under two connectors is two rows.
connector-models.repository.ts replaceMany HARD-DELETES any model absent from the incoming sync (modelKey notIn), destroying history on one bad provider response. Pack forbids this.
GET /connectors/:id/models has no @RequirePermissions while every sibling route requires ADMIN_CONNECTORS_MANAGE.
PlanModelAccess (auth-service) stores provider/model as free strings with no relation to ConnectorModel (connector-service); nothing validates an assignment against synced inventory.

policy.gates: ONE run at the very end of the flagship only. No per-edit or per-batch lint/test/build.
policy.commandApproval: supervisor approves every terminal command; gate commands rejected until the end

knownCeiling: A coding-agent run is bounded at ~100 tool calls: maxModelTurns and maxToolRounds are debited 1:1 per invocation and both are capped at 100 by the protocol schema in BOTH repos, so ULTRA maxToolCalls 250 is unreachable. Every batch must be scoped to fit well under 100 tool calls. Raising it needs a coordinated protocol change in claw-coding-agent and claw-chat-service.
method: The agent ignores prompt-level tool budgets and dies at ~100 model turns. Discovery-shaped tasks fail. Working shape: supervisor names an exact short read list, agent traces and authors. Confirmed on batch 1a.
